subject: Preserve swordfight strength on reciprocal re-entry
description: A swordfight entry could find that the opponent already held the initiator in its reciprocal opponent list. Original recomputes relative fighting ability and takes initiative only when AddOpponent actually inserts a new entry on that side; Rust performed an additional unconditional recomputation for both actors, overwriting the already-engaged opponent's cached strength even though its list was unchanged. Reciprocal re-entry now recomputes only the side whose opponent was newly added, while fresh bilateral entry retains the established updates. The focused asymmetric-entry regression passes.
